sources.title: Brownfield land registers
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: Part 1 lists brownfield sites considered appropriate for residential development; Part 2 is the subset selected for permission in principle. Register inclusion alone is not full planning permission.

sources.title: Permission in principle
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: Permission in principle is a two-stage consent route; detailed development still requires technical details consent, so PIP is not equivalent to a build-ready permission.

sources.title: Brownfield land dataset
sources.verified_claim: The national planning-data dataset aggregates authoritative brownfield-register records and exposes planning-permission and site-status fields; candidate use still requires exact spatial matching.

sources.title: Brownfield Register - Greater London Authority
sources.publisher: Greater London Authority / National Data Library
sources.verified_claim: GLA brownfield GIS boundaries are described as indicative and borough confirmation is advised, so London-wide GIS is not treated as definitive candidate extent.

sources.title: Brownfield Land Register
sources.verified_claim: Havering identifies suitable, available and achievable brownfield sites and distinguishes Part 1 from Part 2; its published site boundaries are explicitly not definitive.

sources.title: Brownfield land register and site maps
sources.verified_claim: Havering provides register downloads and ward site maps; map availability is source material, not proof parcel_46142 intersects a listed site.

sources.title: Brownfield Land Register
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth publishes Part 1 and states its register has no Part 2, so no permission in principle is inferred from a Lambeth Part 1 entry.

sources.title: Lambeth Brownfield Land Register feature layer
sources.verified_claim: The official polygon layer supports GeoJSON/query operations in EPSG:27700; service capability is not evidence that parcel_61522 was intersected.
